story_title: Barley Yield Performance Across Varieties, Sites, and Years (1931-1932)
story_subtitle: Analyzing yield variations by variety, site, and temporal trends to identify optimal cultivation practices

story_pieces.narration: Trebi (65.77 in Waseca 1931) and No. 462 (65.77 in Waseca 1931) achieved the highest single-season yields, outperforming all other varieties. This suggests site-specific conditions may significantly impact yield potential.
story_pieces.question: Which varieties produced the highest individual yields across all sites and years?
story_pieces.visualization: highlighted scatter plot (variety vs. yield) with site/year annotations

story_pieces.narration: University Farm consistently produced higher yields than other sites for most varieties, but Waseca outperformed in 1931 for Trebi and No. 462. This indicates site-specific soil conditions may favor certain varieties.
story_pieces.question: How do site conditions influence yield differences across varieties?
story_pieces.visualization: grouped bar chart (site vs. yield) with variety color-coding

story_pieces.narration: Yields declined across all varieties in 1932 compared to 1931, with Manchuria and Svansota showing the most pronounced drops. This could indicate environmental changes or cultivation challenges during the second year.
story_pieces.question: What were the yield trends between 1931 and 1932 across different varieties?
story_pieces.visualization: line chart (year vs. average yield) with variety-specific lines

story_pieces.narration: Velvet and Manchuria consistently produced lower yields than other varieties across all sites, while Trebi and Wisconsin No. 38 showed greater resilience. This suggests genetic differences in yield stability.
story_pieces.question: Which varieties exhibited the most consistent yield performance across sites?
story_pieces.visualization: box plot (variety vs. yield distribution) with interquartile range

story_pieces.narration: Grand Rapids consistently produced the lowest yields for most varieties, while Crookston showed greater variability. This highlights site-specific challenges in certain regions.
story_pieces.question: How do different sites affect yield variability across varieties?
story_pieces.visualization: bar chart race (site yield rankings) over 1931-1932
